description: Requires a QuantGeeks plan; not available without signing in (the call asks the user to sign in) or with a free account (the call says it needs a plan). The option chain for ONE expiration, compact: by default the 15 strikes on each side of spot, one row per strike with `gex` (QuantGeeks GEX, flow-based, the house value) first, `gex_oi` (open-interest GEX, for comparison) second, then call and put (bid, ask, iv, delta, open interest). The reply opens with the expiration (same-day or days out). Give `center` (a strike) or `from_strike` and `to_strike` to look away from spot, `strikes` (up to 40) to widen, `time` (HH:MM ET), `expiration`. A quote carries `quote_age_s`/`stale` when old and `below_intrinsic` when its bid is under intrinsic value: caveat or skip those. `gex` and `gex_oi` are readable strings such as +$2.0M or −$10.0M (quote them as written). For the GEX ladder alone, use quantgeeks_get_gex_ladder.

center.description: Center the window on this strike instead of spot (e.g. 6550).

date.description: Session date, YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern). Default: the newest session with stored data for the symbol (an overnight session dated today counts).

expiration.description: Option expiration YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the session expiration.

from_strike.description: Lowest strike of a range to show (with to_strike).

strikes.description: Strikes on each side of spot (default 15, at most 40).

symbol.description: Ticker, e.g. SPX (maps to its 0DTE option root SPXW), SPY, QQQ, VIX.

time.description: Time of day HH:MM US Eastern. Default: the latest available minute.

to_strike.description: Highest strike of a range to show.

name: quantgeeks_get_option_chain
title: Option chain with GEX
